evidence_available_before_freeze.v17_scale_decode: Four AVX2 FP32 gathers are issued per sixteen-row group after the two FP16 codebooks are expanded to stack-resident FP32 tables.
evidence_available_before_freeze.v17_assembly_observation: The compiler retained four vgatherdps-family operations and stack spills in the scale-decode path.
evidence_available_before_freeze.representation_status: The three-block PTQ gate failed. The independently preregistered three-block QAT recovery was still running, with no terminal receipt, when v18 was frozen.
evidence_available_before_freeze.claim_boundary: Kernel evidence cannot override a failed representation or quality gate.

hypothesis: A 16-entry FP16 codebook is exactly a byte-shuffle table, not a gather problem. Split each 32-byte FP16 codebook into register-resident low-byte and high-byte tables once per matrix call; use pshufb on the sixteen alpha or mu nibbles, interleave the selected bytes back into FP16 lanes, and convert with F16C. This removes four latency-heavy FP32 gathers and their stack tables from every row-tile/group while preserving every v17 output bit and adding zero artifact or compute-image bytes.

allowed: Replace only the AFF3_X16 v17 alpha/mu codebook gather path with register-resident FP16 byte shuffles.
Build four 16-byte low/high codebook tables once at GEMV entry from the existing two 16-entry FP16 codebooks.
Reuse the v17 AFF3_X16 weight layout, exact centered ternary dot, activation broadcasts, group order, anchors, FMA sequence, and output accumulation order unchanged.
forbidden: Change any stored trit, index, anchor, or codebook value.
Add decoded per-group scales to the persistent or runtime compute image.
Change the row tile, group size, activation quantizer, accumulation order, or mathematical representation.
Retune thresholds after observing v18 timing.

lookup_algebra.input: sixteen 4-bit indices and one 16-entry FP16 codebook
lookup_algebra.required_identity: selected FP32 lane bits equal FP32(codebook_fp16[index]) for every index 0..15

stop_rules: Stop before timing on any codebook lookup bit mismatch, v17/v18 output mismatch, integer-dot mismatch, non-finite output, layout change, or added runtime-image byte.
Do not time while PTQ, QAT, evaluation, or another benchmark consumes the four-core host.
Reject v18 if the frozen 1.05 speedup or either stability threshold fails; retain the negative receipt.
Do not promote v18 into a whole model merely because the primitive passes.
Do not infer unrun model throughput or quality.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only a zero-bpw register-lookup improvement over the already-correct AFF3_X16 v17 primitive on the measured AMD Milan exact shape. Whole-model performance and quality require separate authenticated receipts.
